name: Sovereign's Rime
description: A city of theaters, where three great playhouses compete for audiences. The city's famous bridge, a stone arch so perfectly engineered that it has stood for five centuries. A great bridge with shops built along both sides.
atmosphere: The city's many church doors open and close in a constant rhythm of prayer and devotion.
government: A guild council, with seats based on guild membership size, governs all economic policy.

services.name: The Silken Tunic
services.description: A skilled tailor who can create or repair garments in any style.

services.name: The Country Stallion
services.description: A modest stable with a few reliable mounts available for reasonable rates.

services.name: The Floating Butterfly
services.description: A converted manor house now serving as an inn. The interior is surprisingly elegant.

services.name: Hilltop Provisions & Supplies
services.description: A family-run general store that has served the community for three generations.

services.name: The Burning Forge
services.description: An amateur blacksmith still learning the trade. Prices are low but the work is rough.

services.name: The Tipsy Chimera
services.description: A lively tavern with entertainment nightly. Minstrels, storytellers, and the occasional brawler.

services.name: Nerissa's Antiquities
services.description: A shop specializing in divination services and warded items. Prices are steep but quality is guaranteed.

notableNPCs.name: Aldren
notableNPCs.description: The Clothier of The Silken Tunic. Sharp-eyed and calculating, always looking for an angle.

notableNPCs.name: Ambrose
notableNPCs.description: The Groom of The Country Stallion. Friendly but forgetful, writing everything down in a ledger.

notableNPCs.name: Gralden
notableNPCs.description: The Host of The Floating Butterfly. Friendly but forgetful, writing everything down in a ledger.

notableNPCs.name: Francesca
notableNPCs.description: The Shopkeeper of Hilltop Provisions & Supplies. Talkative and friendly, eager to share local gossip.

notableNPCs.name: Camilla
notableNPCs.description: The Blacksmith of The Burning Forge. Cheerful and optimistic, regardless of circumstances.

notableNPCs.name: Caerthynna
notableNPCs.description: The Barkeep of The Tipsy Chimera. Secretive and private, reluctant to share information.

notableNPCs.name: Rurik
notableNPCs.description: The Hedge Wizard of Nerissa's Antiquities. Secretive and private, reluctant to share information.

rumors: A book found on a dead traveler contains a page that updates itself each day.
A dying courier clutched a bloodstained letter warning of an ambush on the king's road.
threat: A serial arsonist has been targeting warehouses, and the merchant guild is offering a reward.

name: Grimstrike Vault
description: The town's walls are old but well-maintained, with a walkway along the top patrolled by the town guard. A public market cross where proclamations are read and traveling merchants set up their stalls. The town's famous inn, where the ale is said to be the best in the region and the beds are legendary. A covered market hall where traders sell goods regardless of weather, its roof a forest of timber beams. A public school, funded by the town council, offering basic education to all children of citizens.
atmosphere: The press of the crowd at the town hall during elections is a hot, tense, argumentative mass.
government: A mayor elected by all householders governs with the advice of an appointed council of experts.

services.name: The Silver Love
services.description: A small temple to the local patron deity. An acolyte offers blessings for a modest donation.

services.name: Beatrix's Fabric Shop
services.description: A small clothing shop with ready-made items in common sizes.

services.name: Chalice & Butterfly
services.description: A quiet inn with clean rooms and a warm hearth. The rooms are modest but well-kept.

notableNPCs.name: Voren
notableNPCs.description: The Acolyte of The Silver Love. Known for fair dealing and a dry sense of humor.

notableNPCs.name: Gerald
notableNPCs.description: The Tailor of Beatrix's Fabric Shop. Warm and welcoming, treats every guest like family.

notableNPCs.name: Godfrey
notableNPCs.description: The Barkeep of Chalice & Butterfly. Cheerful and optimistic, regardless of circumstances.

rumors: A caravan of undead merchants crosses the salt flats every new moon selling cursed goods.
Grain shipments from the eastern farms have been delayed by bandits.
threat: The town's isolation has bred suspicion of outsiders, making trade and diplomacy nearly impossible.

name: Petranwe Prime
description: A grand city with a great arena, its games drawing crowds of thousands. A stone aqueduct bringing fresh water from the mountains. A great waterwheel powering the city's industry.
atmosphere: The city's many pigeons coo from the rooftops, their droppings whitewashing the cobblestones below.
government: A charter government operates under a royal charter.

services.name: Wren's Curer
services.description: The local butcher also sells leather and bones for craft projects.

services.name: The Twilight Potion
services.description: A front for magical research. The owner is more interested in acquiring rare components than selling.

services.name: Kellan's Leathers
services.description: A small clothing shop with ready-made items in common sizes.

services.name: The Thundering Nail
services.description: A small but busy smithy serving the local farming community. Repairs and tools are their specialty.

services.name: Crustymill
services.description: A baker's shop that serves as an informal gathering place for morning gossip.

services.name: BalladChain
services.description: A discreet guild office tucked behind an unassuming door. Serious inquiries only.

services.description: A converted manor house now serving as an inn. The interior is surprisingly elegant.

A series of small fires have broken out in the warehouse district.
